music.suspendedNoDataIsAvailableWhile: Suspended — no data is available while the subscription is inactive.
music.noStationYouCanReachMatches: No Station you can reach matches “{search}”.
music.stopsBeingSelectableForANew: stops being selectable for a new song or request.
music.pickWhichOneStaysTheRadio: Pick which one stays — the radio beside its name.
music.sayWhyTheseAreTheSame: Say why these are the same record — this is kept as history.
music.recordingARequestByHandNeeds: Recording a request by hand needs permission to see the audience at this Station, which you do not hold. Both ways of naming a listener go through it: the picker reads the audience, and typing somebody's details goes through the same deduplication before anything is written. Nothing here would work without it, so it is not offered.
music.findAListenerAtThisStation: Find a listener at this Station
music.showingTheFirstMatchesNarrowThe: Showing the first matches. Narrow the search to reach the rest.
music.aPhoneEMailCpfOr: A phone, e-mail, CPF or passport is what finds an existing listener, so at least one of the four is needed. Without any, every request would register a fresh listener nobody could ever be matched against again.
music.youCannotRegisterListenersAtThis: You cannot register listeners at this Station, so this only works for somebody who is already here. If nobody holds that identifier yet, the request will be refused rather than registering them.
music.aRequestAlwaysPointsAtA: A request always points at a song already in the catalogue — there is no free-text alternative.
music.leaveBlankToRecordItAs: Leave blank to record it as happening now, in this Station's local time (
music.nobodyAtThisStationHeldThat: Nobody at this Station held that identifier, so the listener was registered as well.
music.searchRequestsByListenerNameOr: Search requests by listener name or phone
music.youCannotSearchByListenerAt: You cannot search by listener at this Station: that needs permission to see the audience here, which you do not hold. Every other filter still works.
music.thisSongHasSinceBeenArchived: This song has since been archived from the catalogue. The request still names it as history.
music.title: Title
music.label: Label
music.youDoNotHoldMusicManage2: You do not hold music.manage at this Station, so this song can be read here but not edited.
music.searchSongsByTitleOrCode: Search songs by title or code
music.noneYetAddFirst: No {kind} yet — add the first one above.
music.noArtistsAreRegisteredInThis: No artists are registered in this Station yet.
music.noSongsAreRegisteredInThis: No songs are registered in this Station yet.
music.noSuchArtistOrYouDo: No such artist, or you do not have permission to see this one.
music.noSuchSongOrYouDo: No such song, or you do not have permission to see this one.
music.thisListenerHasSinceExercisedTheir: This listener has since exercised their right to erasure — their name and phone are no longer stored.
music.withheldYouDoNotHoldMembersView: Withheld — you do not hold members.view at this Station, so listener names and phones are hidden here.
music.thatCouldNotBeFound: That could not be found. Refresh the page and try again.
music.youDoNotHavePermissionToViewTheCatalogue: You do not have permission to view the music catalogue in this Station.
music.couldNotLoadTheCatalogue: Could not load the catalogue. Refresh the page and try again.
music.youCannotYetItStillHasRecords: You cannot {action} yet — it still has other records registered against it. Move or archive them first.
music.youDoNotHavePermissionToHere: You do not have permission to {action} in this Station.
music.couldNotSave: Could not save. Refresh the page and try again.
music.oneOfTheRecordsYouSelected: One of the records you selected is no longer available — it may have been archived or merged by somebody else. Refresh the list and start again.
music.youDoNotHavePermissionToMerge: You do not have permission to merge records in this Station.
music.couldNotMerge: Could not merge. Refresh the page and try again.

vocab.participationMeaningAlreadyEntered: Recorded. This listener had already entered and this promotion takes one entry each, so this one is on the record but not in the draw.
vocab.participationMeaningCameBackTooSoon: Recorded. This listener entered again sooner than this promotion allows, so this one is on the record but not in the draw.
vocab.participationMeaningPastTheirLimit: Recorded. This listener has used every entry this promotion allows them, so this one is on the record but not in the draw.
